greeting: Hi. Tell me about your income, your bills and what you want to keep in budget. I will draft it, and you review it before anything is signed.
mandateBody: A mandate lets bills inside these limits pay themselves. Tightening or revoking it takes effect straight away.
mandateDelay: Creating a mandate needs your passkey and takes effect after 24 hours.
reviewIntro: Check these rules. Signing them sets them with your passkey.
